description:
Kenya's rains rarely give much warning. One minute the sun is out over Ngong Hills, the next a heavy afternoon downpour is soaking everything you're wearing and carrying. A unisex rain poncho is one of the quickest ways to stay dry when that happens. You pull it over your head in seconds, and it covers your body, your arms and your daypack in one go, whether you're a man or a woman, tall or short.

This unisex rain poncho has a roomy, relaxed cut that fits a wide range of body shapes, so couples, friends and families can share the same size. The waterproof shell keeps rain out, and the hood keeps your head and face dry on exposed ridges. Because there are no fitted sleeves or zips, air moves freely underneath, which helps you stay more comfortable than you would in a tight plastic rain coat on a warm, humid climb.

Why Choose a Unisex Rain Poncho?

A unisex rain poncho is simple, light and quick. Unlike a rain jacket, it covers your hips, your thighs and the pack on your back, so your water, snacks and phone stay dry too. It's also easy to share: one unisex rain poncho can be passed between family members or kept in the car as a spare for whoever needs it. For hikers on a budget, it's an affordable way to stay dry without buying a full set of rain gear.

If you prefer a fitted cut for women, take a look at our Waterproof Rain Poncho. For windy, high-altitude treks where a poncho can flap about, the Regatta Waterproof Hooded Jacket gives you a closer fit. Many hikers carry both and choose based on the weather forecast.

Key Features

  • Waterproof shell that keeps heavy rain out
  • Unisex, relaxed cut for men and women
  • Hood that keeps your head and face dry
  • Roomy design that covers your body and daypack
  • Open sides for airflow on warm, humid days
  • Lightweight and easy to fold into a pack

Benefits

Here's what a unisex rain poncho adds to your outdoor kit:

  • Fast protection: Pull it on in seconds when the rain starts.
  • Dry gear too: Covers your daypack as well as your body.
  • One size for many people: Share it between partners, friends or family.
  • Cooler than a plastic coat: Open sides let warm air escape.
  • Great value: An affordable way to stay dry on every trip.

Perfect For

  • Day hikes during the long and short rains
  • Forest and waterfall hikes
  • Camping trips and outdoor festivals
  • Walking, cycling and boda rides in town
  • Safari game drives and sightseeing
  • Keeping a spare in the car for emergencies

Where to Use a Unisex Rain Poncho in Kenya

A unisex rain poncho earns its place in your bag during the long rains from March to May and the short rains from October to December. Forest trails in Karura, Kereita and Ngare Ndare can turn wet very quickly, and the Aberdares and Mt Elgon are known for mist and steady drizzle. Ngong Hills, Mt Longonot and Elephant Hill are fully exposed, so a sudden storm leaves nowhere to shelter.

It's just as useful at a campsite in Naivasha, on a waterfall walk at Sagana or Thika, or simply getting around Nairobi in an afternoon downpour. On longer treks such as Mt Kenya, wear it over your warm layers on the lower forest sections, and switch to a fitted rain jacket higher up where the wind is stronger.

Ponchos have been used for centuries as simple, effective rain protection, and they remain popular with hikers and travellers for their speed and coverage. You can read more about their history and design in this overview of the poncho. For anyone who hikes or travels in Kenya's rainy seasons, a unisex rain poncho is a small, light item that saves a lot of discomfort.

Frequently Asked Questions

Will a unisex rain poncho fit both men and women?

Yes. The relaxed, roomy cut is designed to fit a wide range of body types, so the same poncho works for men and women. If you're very tall or plan to wear it over a large pack, message us and we'll confirm the fit.

Is a poncho better than a rain jacket?

A poncho covers more of you and your pack, is quicker to put on and stays cooler in warm, humid weather. A rain jacket is better in strong wind because it fits closer to your body. For most rainy-season day hikes in Kenya, a poncho does the job well.

Does it cover a backpack?

The unisex rain poncho's roomy shape is made to go over a daypack. For a large trekking pack, check with us on WhatsApp first so we can confirm it will cover it.

How do I care for it?

Rinse your unisex rain poncho with clean water after a muddy hike, shake it off and hang it to dry before folding it away. Avoid storing it wet, which can cause mildew.
